description: Look up a GW1 hero by name or by id (GWCA HeroID, matching the AccountExport plugin output). Returns profession, campaign and how the hero is unlocked. Remember: heroes can equip any skill unlocked at ACCOUNT level, but NO PvE-only skill at all — including Signet of Capture. validate_build with forHero=true reports each one as an error, not a warning. Use this for one known hero; to browse or filter the roster, use list_heroes instead.
name: get_hero
title: Get a Guild Wars 1 hero
